title: Draft invoices
purpose: Find drafts and issued invoices, including cancelled and voided records. Only project managers and administrators can use this directory.
summary: Find drafts and issued invoices, including cancelled and voided records. Only project managers and administrators can use this directory.

tasks.title: Find an invoice record
steps: Enter an invoice or draft number, client, account code, chain of custody, project or purchase order in [[Search]].
Choose a [[Status]] if needed and select [[Apply]].
Select the number to open the billing snapshot, history and any issued PDF.

tasks.title: Prepare a new draft
steps: Open the received chain of custody from Chains of custody.
Select [[New draft invoice]] on that record, then choose an active price list or a matching accepted quote version.

tasks.title: Find records taken out of use
steps: Choose Cancelled for drafts or Voided for issued invoices in [[Status]], then select [[Apply]].

tasks.title: Find invoice records by due date
steps: Enter [[Due from]], [[Due through]] or both, then select [[Apply]].
Select [[Due date]] to sort the matching records.

good_to_know: The directory includes all four statuses by default.
Amounts and client labels come from the draft snapshot; changing the client or price list does not update them.
Once issued, an invoice keeps its number and PDF, even after a void.
Date filters exclude records without a due date.

sections.title: Access and purpose
paragraphs: Only project managers and administrators can open or change invoice records. Drafts and issued records stay in the staff workspace. Staff issue an active draft from its detail page and deliver the PDF separately. Staff enter due dates and tax amounts. The invoice workflow has no payment or accounting entry.

items.label: Search
items.description: Matches issued invoice number, draft number, saved client name, account code, chain-of-custody reference, project name and PO. Apply runs the search on the full authorized directory.

items.label: Status
items.description: All statuses, Draft, Cancelled, Issued or Voided. Invalid choices show a filter error; correct the field to continue.

items.label: Due from / Due through
items.description: Optional inclusive calendar-date bounds. Either bound excludes records without a due date. Leave both blank to include undated records. Due through must be on or after Due from. Invalid dates or a reversed range show field errors and no records until corrected. Filters combine with Search and Status across all pages.

items.label: Invoice / draft
items.description: Links to the staff record. Issued and voided invoices show the invoice number with its draft ID beneath it. Other records show only the draft ID. The latest draft IDs appear first by default.

items.label: Client / Chain of custody
items.description: Saved billing client label and source order reference.

items.label: Total (USD)
items.description: Exact sum of saved line amounts. Cancelled and voided records retain their original total for reference. The total includes any manually entered tax assessments; missing tax lines do not establish tax applicability.

items.label: Created
items.description: Date and time the draft was created, in the deployment time zone.

items.label: Due date
items.description: Staff-entered payment date, shown as YYYY-MM-DD or Not recorded. Staff enter it independently of payment terms. Sorting applies to the whole result set. Ascending order places undated records last and descending order places them first. Equal dates are ordered by internal record ID.

items.label: Project / Purchase order
items.description: Saved project label and PO; initially hidden columns available from Columns.

items.label: Sort / Columns / rows per page
items.description: Sortable headers order the full result set. Columns shows, hides or reorders columns. Pagination and row counts apply to all matching records; preferences are saved per account.

items.label: Clear all / empty and no-results states
items.description: Clear active filters. An empty directory points you to a received chain of custody; no matches asks you to change or clear the filters.

sections.title: Explicit tax assessments
paragraphs: Tax assessments are entered manually on an active draft through Add fee, discount or tax. Each requires a description identifying its basis or source, quantity exactly 1 and a nonnegative whole-cent USD amount. Multiple assessments may be separate lines. Tax lines have no quote, sample or requested-test source. Creation from a price list or accepted quote never creates a tax line.

There are no tax rates, taxability or exemption decisions, or automatic tax calculations. The exact draft total includes every entered assessment. Changing test, fee or discount charges never recalculates tax: review each tax assessment separately after changing charges. Zero retains an explicit assessment; a missing tax line makes no tax determination. Tax lines cannot be deleted or change kind; correct an amount to zero with a reason. Cancellation retains the lines and their history.
